recommendedArguments.title: -fullscreen
recommendedArguments.detail: Starts in exclusive fullscreen, which gives the lowest presentation latency on most systems.

recommendedArguments.title: +fps_max 0
recommendedArguments.detail: Removes the frame rate cap. Use a cap slightly below your refresh rate instead if you run G-SYNC/FreeSync.

process.reason: Slightly favours the game over background applications while it runs. Restored when the game exits.

systemRecommendations.reason: Game Mode reduces background activity from Windows Update and notifications while playing.
Background recording costs GPU encoder time and disk writes.
Raw, unaccelerated mouse input is expected in competitive shooters. CS2 uses raw input in-game, this mainly affects menus and the desktop.

optimizationRules.reason: Keeps CPU clocks high during rounds.

graphicsGuidance.title: Boost Player Contrast: Enabled
graphicsGuidance.detail: Improves player visibility with negligible cost.

graphicsGuidance.title: NVIDIA Reflex / AMD Anti-Lag
graphicsGuidance.detail: Enable Reflex (On + Boost if GPU-bound) to reduce system latency.

graphicsGuidance.title: Multisampling (MSAA)
graphicsGuidance.detail: Most expensive setting on mid-range GPUs; use 2x or 4x if the 1% lows drop below your refresh rate.

networkGuidance.title: Wired connection
networkGuidance.detail: Wi-Fi adds jitter that sub-tick movement is sensitive to. Check the STORM network score for jitter.

benchmark.scenario: Workshop map 'CS2 FPS Benchmark' or an offline Dust II walk-through using the same route each run.
